state_model:
ONE STORE: state/store.ts, an external store read with useSyncExternalStore and selectors. It holds discrete UI state only. Per-frame data never goes into React state.

AppState
- datasets: {status, entries, error?}
- active: none | loading{key} | ready{key, recording} | invalid{key, reason} | error{key}. The key is 'pub:<id>:<audioId>' or 'up:<runId>'.
- upload: {runId, fileName, progress, error, elapsedMs, downmixWarning}
- view: {axes: AxisMask 1..7, transition: {from, to, plan, startedAt} | null, autoRotate, fitRequest}
- playback: {main: idle | playing | paused | ended, reveal: all | follow}
- pointer: {hover: {index, clientX, clientY} | null}
- selection: {a, b}
- compare: {playing: a | b | sequence | null, loop, sharedScale: true}
- ui: {detailsOpen, helpOpen, menuOpen, keyCollapsed, compareHintSeen}
- dev: {preview}. The store forces this to false when env.build is 'prod'.

Invariants (all in the pure reducer, all tested)
- The axes are never 0. Turning off the last axis does nothing and shows a hint.
- A new active key clears selection, hover and compare.playing, sets reveal to 'all' and main to 'idle', and stops slot audio.
- Selection indices are always below n, and a is never equal to b.
- applyClick: fills A, then B. Later clicks replace B. Shift-click replaces A. Clicking a selected dot removes it. Esc clears both.
- Only one source is audible at a time: SLOT_PLAYING pauses main, and main playing stops the slot.
- Main playing or a seek sets reveal to 'follow'. REVEAL_ALL (the 'Show all' chip) is allowed only while not playing.
- Any Upload action carrying a stale runId is ignored.
- The initial axes come from ?view=x|y|z|xy|xz|yz|xyz; anything else gives xyz.

Outside React state
- The hidden HTMLAudioElement is the only cloud clock. Shaders and ScreenLayer read audio.currentTime inside useFrame. revealTime gives +Infinity when reveal is 'all', which shows the whole cloud and every label candidate with no pulse and no trail.
- screenFrame: reused Float32Arrays of sx, sy, depth, radiusCss, revealed and drawOrder. Written once per frame by ScreenLayer. Read by labels, pickAt, rings and the tooltip.
- engine: one lazily created AudioContext and the current PlayHandle.
- clipStore: Map<recordingKey, {status, origin, buffer, mono, sampleRate}>. Every lookup requires key equality, so one file's audio can never pair with another file's dots.
- CameraRig owns both cameras and the saved 3D pose.

Derived with useMemo (never stored)
- gate table: evaluateGates({recording, accepted, approvedCopy, env, view, clipStatus, selfCheck})
- labelCandidates(points, 40)
- amplitudeMax
- colorMaxHz: the maximum over the points, which is production's resolveCentroidColorMaxHz rule
- the key gradient from restingDotDisplayRgb
- measuredRows for the hovered dot, A and B
evidence_gating:
PRINCIPLE
- The viewer never computes a verdict or threshold.
- It only computes a number with the exact formula an accepted experiment defines (ev[A] per Exp 011 C25), and it renders only what the evidence allows.
- One pure function, evaluateGates, decides everything and fails closed. Anything missing, malformed, NaN or an unknown enum value gives 'hidden' with typed reasons.
- The always-on, evidence-independent list is declared and asserted in a test: cloud, labels, key, axisViews, grid, gizmo, transportWaveform, tooltip, picking, compareValues, upload, downloads.

LOCK 1: THE VIEWER'S ACCEPTANCE LIST (evidence/accepted.ts)
- ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE = {exp007..exp012A, exp012A8: null}.
- APPROVED_COPY = {linesWording, linesNonE3Wording, viewQualityTerms, axisCaptions, uploadListening, description: false}.
- A record is {resultsPath, resultsSha256, decisionId, acceptedOn, verificationRef, summary}. The typed summaries hold:
  - exp007: per-view labels and whether the edge-wording upgrade is allowed;
  - exp008: per-view outcome and whether the flag may be shown;
  - exp009: outcome, space, k, gap;
  - exp010: outcome;
  - exp011: templatesSha256;
  - exp012A: R5 or R6; certified constants {22050, 1024, 512, 6, 3584}; ffmpegBuilds [{versionLine, sha256, platform, arch}] with this PC's 6.1.1 first (decision 5); blocked source sha256 values; excluded format groups;
  - exp012A8: groups that passed.
- It changes only through an owner-approved commit, after an independent re-derivation.
- test/accepted.test.ts checks every non-null record: the file exists under ../05_Benchmark_Results/v2/, its SHA-256 matches, and the notebook's Status line is no longer 'Pre-registered'.

LOCK 2: PER-RECORDING PAYLOAD EVIDENCE (Phase 4, Exp 011 schema)
- contractVersion must be 2.
- evidence.exp0NN.status must be exactly 'decided'. Pending, not-run, suspended, provisional, owner-decision-pending, exploratory and missing all fail closed (C24).
- resultsSha256 must equal the accepted record's.
- The C14 consistency check must have passed for any gate reading 007, 008 or 012B.
- The feature's block must parse. Upload payloads carry no evidence, so every gated feature is closed for them, except uploadListening (below).

LOCK 3: APPROVED WORDING
- Every sentence of a gated feature comes from copy/gated.ts through its OpenGate, and any wording that is not pre-committed also needs its APPROVED_COPY flag.
- The OpenGate<T> brand is created only in gates.ts, and a guard test checks this. Gated components accept only OpenGate<T>, and @ts-expect-error tests prove that plain data does not compile.

PER-FEATURE CONDITIONS
- similarityLines:
  - Needs exp009 accepted with a decision that allows lines, and exp007 accepted.
  - A v1 payload (no similaritySpace) counts as E3 with k = similarityNeighbors and gap = similarityMinTimeGapSeconds. It must match the accepted space, k and gap.
  - E3 lines appear only in xyz (C23 G7.4), worded 'closest in this 3D projection', or 'similar spectrogram content (in the analysed feature space)' only if the exp007 upgrade flag is set.
  - Non-E3 spaces are hidden unless linesNonE3Wording is approved (C23(2)).
  - Wording is never perceptual.
- linkedMoments: needs similarityLines shown. Time ticks on the transport strip also need momentPlayback-level timing evidence.
- viewQuality:
  - Needs exp008 and exp007 accepted, plus the viewPreservation block with finite T, T_G and margin for the current view, plus viewQualityTerms.
  - It shows T, T_G and the margin at 2 dp, the exact label for the view, and the weak flag only where allowed.
  - 'Keeps X%' = evRule(pcaExplainedVarianceRatio, view). It shows only while those view values show (G2a.4) and G2a.1 holds: length 3, each value in [0, 1], and the sum equals pcaExplainedVarianceTotal within 1e-9.
  - A 'deferred' status shows 'not yet measured' (Exp 008 F2).
- axisCaptions:
  - Needs exp010 and exp007 accepted, axisMeaning[a].status 'labelled', display.axisEndsLabelled, the axis toggled on, and axisCaptions approved. That approval is pending, because the current templates break the readability rules.
  - If the method gates failed, only the fixed Exp 010 statement and the numbers are shown.
- axisLoadings: needs exp010 accepted and a finite 3 x 24 x 6 grid.
- description: needs exp011 accepted, description approved, and readabilityStatus[lang] 'reviewed' (plus 'reviewed-fluent' for ES/PT). payload.display must equal cloud/constants. Each sentence's runtime gate must hold. Low priority.
- momentPlayback (published recordings):
  - exp012A accepted with R5 or R6.
  - Every point has finite audioStartSeconds < audioEndSeconds <= durationSeconds.
  - framesPerPoint, stftHopSize, fftSize and sampleRate equal the certified constants.
  - The payload's decoder sha256 is in ffmpegBuilds, and its sourceSha256 is not blocked.
  - origin is 'source-file': basename(audioUrl) === source.filename and browserPlayable.
  - At runtime: decoded.sampleRate === R_s, and every span fits inside the decoded length.
  - Production builds also need formatGroup in exp012A8.passed.
- uploadListening: needs origin 'upload', and verifyAnalysisSpans must pass on every point. Production builds also need uploadListening approved.

WHAT VISITORS SEE WHEN EVIDENCE IS ABSENT
- Nothing: no element, no placeholder, no 'coming soon', and the layout closes up.
- Compare cards keep their measured values but show no waveform and no play button.
- The key has no lines row.
- No duration such as 0.16 s appears anywhere.

DEV-ONLY OWNER PREVIEW
- When it exists: import.meta.env.DEV, plus ?preview or the Owner-panel switch.
- What it can show: only data that exists in the payload (3D edges, in xyz only; raw v2 blocks as data) and grid-derived spans from dev/devSpans.ts:
  - sf = round(emissionTime * sampleRate / hop), which must be an integer within 1e-9;
  - the span is [512*sf, 512*sf + 3584) / 22050;
  - it never uses samplingWindowSeconds or the point id.
- Marking: every previewed element carries a hatched 'UNVERIFIED · Exp 0NN' chip. The screen gets a hatched frame and a banner.
- Compare caveats in preview:
  - before Part A: 'UNVERIFIED: moment timing derived from the analysis grid; Experiment 012 has not run.';
  - after Part A, before A.8: the C05 template with V filled.
- Simulated evidence: runs the real gated components on fixture records, watermarked 'SIMULATED EVIDENCE'.

WHY PREVIEW CANNOT REACH PRODUCTION
1. Dev code lives only in src/dev and is reachable only through devHook.ts's `import.meta.env.DEV ? lazy(import(...)) : null`. Vite replaces DEV with false and emits no chunk. A devIsolation test fails if any other file imports src/dev.
2. evaluateGates never returns 'preview' when env.build is 'prod' (unit test).
3. Every dev module embeds __OWNER_PREVIEW__. check-dist fails the build on that sentinel, the dev words, or an OwnerPanel chunk.
4. prebuild runs every guard test, so npm run build fails on any guard.

SOURCE-TEXT GUARDS
- claimText scans string literals and JSX text in src (except frozen analysis/) against scripts-level banned patterns:
  - sound(s) alike / similar / like, similar-sounding, same note, repeats itself;
  - 0.15 s or 0.15-second;
  - r = 0.x, few percent, typically, multi-scale, coming soon;
  - plus the Exp 011 A3 EN denylist, for gated description text only.
- copyCoverage: no JSX text with letters outside the copy files.
- notebookVerbatim: every verbatim entry occurs in its notebook, including the C05 caveat template and Exp 007 line 383.
- gatesClosed: the committed accepted list plus every fixture, forged_v2 included, leaves every gate closed.

features.name: Single screen, recording menu, centre states
features.gated_by: none
features.design:
LAYOUT
- Full-bleed canvas, background #04050a.
- Header card top-left, 16 px inset, 320 px: wordmark, then commonName as the title with a menu arrow, then the subline '{d} s · {n} dots'.
- View bar top-centre. Top-right: help, more menu, and Owner (dev only).
- Key bottom-left. Transport along the bottom, 56 px. Compare tray above the transport. Side panels on the right, 320 px.
- Panel style: rgba(10,11,16,.78) fill, 1 px #232838 border, radius 10.

RECORDING MENU
- Lists the manifest entries, then 'Analyse a file from this computer…'.
- ?dataset= picks the recording; otherwise 'sample', otherwise the first entry.

CENTRE STATES
- Loading.
- No recordings (in dev, with the generate command).
- An invalid file, with the exact normalizer reason.
- A newer version: 'This file uses format version {v}; this viewer reads versions 1 and 2.'
- Upload progress, using the pipeline's stage names.

NARROW SCREENS (<700 px): the key and the tray collapse into sheets, and there is no horizontal scroll.

features.name: Canonical v0.7 Matte cloud
features.gated_by: none (constants copied exactly; tested)
features.design:
- matteFragment is kept exactly.
- Matte numbers: haloScale 1, maxBall 200 device px, restColor .95, recentColor .4, restAlpha .95, recentAlpha 0, revealFloor .4, normal blending.
- Reveal .28 s. Recent .7 s. Pulse 1 + recent*(.6 + 1.3*flux). Size max(.035, amp/ampMax)*62*dpr*9/depth.
- Colour = plasma(spectralCentroidHz / colorMaxHz).
- Camera [8,5,9], fov 52, dpr [1,2]. Orbit: damping .08, autoRotate .5, no pan.

Fixes
- The pixel ratio is read from gl.getPixelRatio() every frame.
- 3D is drawn back to front through a per-frame index buffer (n ≤ 700). Flat views draw the largest dots first.
- The core glow is removed.
- The comet is replaced by a 1.5 px white ring on currentPointIndex(t) while playing.
- There is no style, size or label-value picker.

features.name: 40 peak-frequency numbers
features.gated_by: none (Exp 011 S5 candidate rule kept exactly)
features.design:
CANDIDATES: the time-ordered points, stable-sorted by raw amplitude (highest first), first min(40, n). No 0 Hz filter.

TEXT: formatLabelK gives '5.43K' with Exp 011 rounding. A candidate with amplitude <= 0 keeps its slot but draws no text.

DRAWN on the overlay canvas in the canonical glyph style: weight 600 ui-monospace / Cascadia Mono / Consolas, 13 CSS px box, dark round halo rgba(2,4,10,.85), fill #f2f5fb.

PLACEMENT, loudest first, every frame
- One labelBox() gives both the drawn box and the collision box. It starts 4 px beyond the live pulsed and clamped ball radius from ballRadiusCss.
- A label is hidden if its dot is not revealed, if it is off-screen or behind the camera, or if it would come within 3 px of a placed box.
- The same function works for both camera types.
- Nothing is allocated per frame.

features.name: Key that matches the dots
features.gated_by: none; the lines row only with the similarityLines gate
features.design:
COLOUR ROW
- Label: 'average frequency (spectral centroid)'.
- 8 px gradient built from restingDotDisplayRgb(t) = linear plasma * .95 * .95 at alpha .874 over #04050a. This is exactly what the shader writes, since there is no colour-space conversion in the shader.
- Ticks 0, ¼, ½, ¾ and max, in kHz to 1 dp.

SIZE ROW: 3D and flat views get different construction text.

NUMBERS ROW: 'strongest frequency in kHz, on the {n} dots with the strongest signal. Numbers that would overlap are hidden.'

PLAYBACK ROWS (trail, swell) show only while playing or paused part-way, with the chip 'Showing moments up to {m:ss.s} · Show all'.

CHECKS: a test compares the stops with the formula. A dev pixel readback must match within ±2/255.

features.name: Rest state and playback reveal
features.gated_by: none
features.design:
- At load, before play, after the end, and after 'Show all': uTime = +Infinity. All dots and all label candidates show, with no swell and no trail.
- Play: the cloud reveals by audio.currentTime, exactly as in v0.7.
- Pause part-way keeps the partial reveal. Seek moves it.
- Labels and picking use only revealed dots.

features.name: X/Y/Z toggles: 1D line, 2D scatter, 3D cloud
features.gated_by: none (meets Exp 008's one-uniform-scale requirement by construction; no per-view numbers)
features.design:
CHIPS
- Three 36 px chips X, Y, Z (aria-pressed; the last active chip is aria-disabled).
- Readout: '3D view', '2D view · X and Y' or '1D view · X'.
- Tooltips: 'X: first PCA direction' (likewise for Y and Z).
- Flat views get a Fit button; 3D gets a turn toggle.
- Keys X, Y, Z and F. ?view= sets the start view.

Details are in axis_views.

features.name: Flat-view grid, ± end marks, 3D gizmo
features.gated_by: none
features.design:
- Square grid: step 1, 2 or 5 × 10^k world units, 6-12 lines across, rgba(255,255,255,.06), no numbers.
- '−X' left, '+X' right, and so on, 11 px #8a93a6. This follows Exp 010's '+X/−X' convention.
- 3D: a grey, non-interactive drei GizmoHelper triad, never in plasma colours. Red is reserved for 'now playing'.

features.name: Transport with full-clip waveform and red playhead
features.gated_by: none for the waveform (the file's own decoded samples). Dot-time marks on the strip are gated by Exp 012.
features.design:
- Play/pause button, then the clock '0:07.4 / 0:13.7', then a min/max strip from overviewColumns of the decoded mono (played part #9aa3b2, unplayed #5b6477).
- A 2 px #ff3b30 playhead at audio.currentTime.
- Click or drag to seek; ← and → step 1 s.
- Before the decode finishes, and if it fails, the strip is a plain track.
- The decode is lazy, after first paint, and shared with compare through clipStore.
- Known residual risk: nothing checks that the audio element's timeline and the decoded timeline line up (for example, MP3 encoder delay). This goes to the owner as a question.

features.name: Hover tooltip
features.gated_by: none (payload fields with code definitions)
features.design:
- Opens after 80 ms on a revealed dot: a ring at radius + 3, and a card at the cursor + 14 px.
- Rows:
  - 'Starts at {s.ss} s'
  - 'Strongest frequency {x.xx} kHz'
  - 'Average frequency {x.xx} kHz', with a swatch
  - 'Signal strength {p}% of the strongest', or 'under 1%'
  - 'Click to compare'
- Never shown: position numbers, normalised fields, the id, an end time, or 'what you hear'.

compare_mode:
PICKING
- pickPoint over screenFrame, using the same ballRadiusCss the shader and labels use.
- The topmost revealed disc wins, otherwise the nearest within 6 px.
- Clicks: A, then B; later clicks replace B; shift replaces A; clicking a selected dot removes it; Esc clears.
- autoRotate pauses while the pointer is over the canvas or a slot is filled.

AUDIO SOURCE (always on the main thread; decoded lazily after first paint, cached per recording key)
- Published recordings:
  - fetch(audioUrl), then decodeAudioData in new (OfflineAudioContext ?? webkitOfflineAudioContext)({numberOfChannels: source.channels, length: 1, sampleRate: R_s = source.sampleRateHz}). This is the Exp 012 A.8 path.
  - Keep every channel for playback, and the channel mean for drawing (A.8's x_b).
  - classifyPlaybackSource: 'source-file' only when basename(decodeURIComponent(audioUrl)) === source.filename and browserPlayable; '_playback.mp3' gives 'transcode'; no source gives 'unknown'.
  - If the context rejects R_s (for example 192 kHz): decode at 48 kHz for the transport strip only, marked 'browser-resampled'. Moment playback is refused.
  - A decoded sampleRate other than R_s is refused.
- Uploads: the kept 22050 Hz mono under up:<runId>, origin 'analysis-rate'. verifyAnalysisSpans recomputes every point's RMS over [512·sf, 512·sf + 3584) with pipeline.ts's exact frameRms order and requires === point.amplitude.

SAMPLE RANGE
- Span sources: certifiedSpan (payload audioStartSeconds/audioEndSeconds, finite, s < e ≤ durationSeconds); the Upload construction span; devSpans in preview.
- Never samplingWindowSeconds, never point.id.
- A = Math.round(s·R) and B = Math.round(e·R), computed independently at the decoded buffer's own rate. At 48 kHz, B − A is 7801 or 7802.
- The slot is refused, never clamped, if A < 0, B > length, or A ≥ B.

PLAYBACK (audio/engine.ts)
- One realtime AudioContext, created and resumed inside the click handler.
- Per play: createBuffer(channels, B − A, rate), copyToChannel(channel.subarray(A, B)) for each channel, then an AudioBufferSourceNode straight to the destination.
- No fade and no gain change, so the slice is bit-exact (a fade is an owner question and would have to be documented under Exp 012).
- start(ctx.currentTime + 0.02). Loop repeats the same buffer. 'Play A, then B' leaves a 0.3 s gap.
- One slot at a time. A slot pauses the audio element, and the audio element's play event stops the slot.

DETAILED WAVEFORM (MomentWaveform, canvas)
- Full card width × 88 CSS px, backing store at DPR. Background #0a0d16, zero line rgba(255,255,255,.08).
- One column per device pixel: sliceMinMax over [A + floor(c·N/cols), A + floor((c+1)·N/cols)), drawn as a ≥1 device px vertical bar in the slot colour at 85%. Every sample lands in exactly one column.
- Fewer than 2 samples per column: a polyline through the samples instead. (0.1625 s at 48 kHz on 460 px at DPR 2 is about 8.5 samples per column.)
- Shared scale by default: the larger |peak| of A and B; the toggle fits each card to its own peak. Scale label '±{peak}'.
- Time labels '0 s' and '{(B−A)/R} s' only when the span is certified, or in preview.
- Multichannel note: 'Picture shows the channels averaged; you hear all channels.'
- Redrawn only when the slice, width or scale changes.

RED PLAYHEAD
- A 2 CSS px #ff3b30 div with a 6 px cap, moved by transform: translateX on requestAnimationFrame. The waveform is never redrawn for it.
- fraction = playheadFraction(heard, startAt, (B − A)/rate, loop).
- heard = getOutputTimestamp().contextTime + (performance.now() − performanceTime)/1000, falling back to ctx.currentTime − (outputLatency || baseLatency || 0). So it tracks what is heard, not what is scheduled.
- Hidden when idle. Wraps on loop. The ring of the playing slot pulses.
- Red is used only for 'now playing', here and in the transport.

WHAT A CARD SHOWS
- Now (production): values only.
- Dev preview: the waveform, play and playhead from devSpans, with an UNVERIFIED chip and the pre-Part-A caveat.
- After Part A (dev): the C05 caveat with V filled; R5 adds codec smearing in ms from the accepted record.
- Production: also needs A.8 passed for the format group.
- Upload: the note 'You hear the audio as it was analysed: one channel, resampled to 22.05 kHz by this browser.', shown once uploadListening is open.
axis_views:
MAPPING
- X = position[0] = PC1, Y = position[1] = PC2, Z = position[2] = PC3. AXIS_MAPPING {x:0, y:1, z:2}, test-asserted against Exp 011's display.axisMapping.
- The axis mask is 3 bits and never 0.

ONE GEOMETRY
- Positions are never rewritten. The vertex shaders for points, trail and edges multiply by a binary vec3 uAxisMask that zeroes the dropped axes. It is never animated.
- viewBasis(mask) gives right, up and back = right × up, all right-handed:
  - XY: right +X, up +Y, camera on +Z;
  - XZ: right +X, up +Z, camera on −Y;
  - YZ: right +Y, up +Z, camera on +X;
  - 1D: right is the axis.
- So on screen u = p[h] and v = p[v] exactly, with positive values right and up. projectToView is tested for all 7 views.

UNIFORM SCALE (Exp 008)
- No jitter, no time axis, no per-axis stretch or recentring. The exporter's single 6/max|score| scale stands.
- fitOrtho returns ONE world-per-pixel value: the larger extent fills its side minus a 12% margin, and the frame is centred on the extents' midpoint. PC2 and PC3 look thinner, which is correct.
- A property test checks that display distances = zoom × component distances.

3D: the v0.7 perspective camera and OrbitControls. The pose is saved on leaving 3D and restored on return.

1D/2D
- OrthographicCamera along −back, with rotation locked (enableRotate false) and autoRotate off.
- Uniform wheel/pinch zoom and pan (owner question). Fit (F) restores the frame.
- Dot size uses uOrthoDepth = equivalentOrthoDepth(worldHeight) = worldHeight / (2·tan 26°). Sizes match 3D at the swap and scale with zoom.
- Draw order: largest first, ties in time order.

TRANSITIONS: every frame shows real data from a real angle; no axis is ever scaled.
- 3D ↔ 2D: about 700 ms cubic in-out rigid rotation of the perspective camera to or from the target basis. The swap to or from ortho happens at matched scale. The mask change happens only along the view direction, so it is invisible.
- 2D ↔ 2D: through the same rigid rotation in perspective.
- Any change involving 1D: a 140 ms cross-fade (uFade plus overlay globalAlpha).
- prefers-reduced-motion: instant.
- Picking, the tooltip and labels pause during transitions.

LAYERS
- Every view: dots, labels, rings, the now-ring.
- Trail: 2D and 3D, hidden in 1D.
- E3 lines: xyz only (C23 G7.4). They fade out as a 3D → 2D transition begins. No '3D-derived' label is drawn in flat views.
- The same 40 label candidates in every view. A dense 1D view shows few numbers, which is expected; density is never relieved by jitter.
tests:
HARNESS
- node:test on Node 24.14.1 with native type stripping. No new dependency. Precedent: tools/verify_browser_port_parity.mjs imports pipeline.ts this way.
- app/test/**/*.test.ts, run by `npm test`. Type-checked through tsconfig.test.json (lib ES2023, no DOM), which is referenced from tsconfig.json, so tsc -b covers it. prebuild runs npm test.
- Pure modules use explicit .ts imports, no enums, and nothing from react, three, the DOM or import.meta.env. Tests do not import three either: expected colour values are computed from the sRGB formula in the test.
- Fixtures are synthetic. There is no corpus data.

CASES

reducer / selection
- A, then B, then B replaced; shift replaces A; re-click removes; indices ≥ n rejected.
- A new key clears hover, selection and playing, and sets reveal to 'all'.
- The last axis cannot be turned off. ?view parsing for all 7 values plus garbage.
- Audio exclusivity. A stale Upload runId is ignored. Preview stays false in a prod store.

normalize
- The four shapes are accepted. An array-valued cloud is not unwrapped.
- Upload unification: sourceSampleRateHz; top-level centroidTrack.
- contractVersion: missing → 1; 2 accepted; 3 → newer-version; 1.5 or '2' → malformed.
- Errors: empty points; a 2-number, NaN or Infinity position (with its index); decreasing emissionTime (equal times allowed); a negative or non-finite amplitude.
- Out-of-range, [a,a] and non-integer edges are dropped and counted; valid edges keep their order.
- analysisSampleRateHz falls back to sampleRate. colorMaxHz is the point maximum, with a warning when it differs from centroidMaxHz.
- raw is never mutated (a deep-frozen input does not throw). audioStart/End are kept only when finite.

manifest.pickInitialDataset: the requested id, then 'sample', then the first entry; an empty list → null.

pointSpan
- certifiedSpan: valid only with both values finite and s < e ≤ duration.
- toSampleRange: independent rounding; at 48 kHz over sf 0..2000, B − A takes both 7801 and 7802; A < 0, B > length or A ≥ B → null (never clamped).
- Changing samplingWindowSeconds or the id never changes the output.

devSpans
- sf recovered exactly for {0, 1, 7, 12345}.
- +1e-7 s → unavailable. Missing hop fields → unavailable.
- Span length 3584/22050.

gates
- The committed accepted list plus every fixture, forged_v2 included → all hidden with reasons.
- Each status pending / not-run / suspended / provisional / owner-decision-pending / exploratory / unknown → hidden.
- sha mismatch, malformed block, or missing approved copy → hidden.
- Lines: simulated exp009 E3 (k 3, gap 1.5) plus a v1 payload → shown in xyz, hidden in xy ('view-not-3d'); a k mismatch → hidden; non-E3 without approved wording → hidden.
- viewQuality: deferred → 'not yet measured'; a missing T for one view closes only that view; ev hidden when the view block is hidden (G2a.4) or when G2a.1 fails.
- momentPlayback hidden for each of: an uncertified span, a transcode, a resampled decode, an unknown ffmpeg sha, a blocked source, a span outside the buffer, and (prod) A.8 missing for the group. Dev with Part A open → shown with the V-filled caveat.
- uploadListening: a failed or pending self-check → hidden; prod needs approval.
- A prod build with preview requested never gives 'preview'.
- The evidence-independent list equals the declared set.

evRule
- Addition in x, y, z order.
- Decimal-shift percent: 0.285 → 29, 0.145 → 15.
- ev > 0 but rounding to 0 → 'under 1%'.
- Matches Exp 011 C25 examples.

accepted: every non-null record's file exists and its sha matches. Today all records are null and all copy flags false.

format
- 1.005 → '1.01'. −2.5 → '−3'. −0 → '0'.
- 5426.3671875 Hz → '5.43K' and '5.43 kHz'. 11025 → '11.03K'.
- formatClock(7.43) → '0:07.4'. 20·log10(0.1) → '−20.0'. Amplitude 0 → null.
- A seeded property test of 10^4 values against Intl.NumberFormat halfExpand.

channels
- labelCandidates equals map/sort/slice(0,40) on random fixtures; ties go to the earlier index; n < 40 → n; 0 Hz is not filtered.
- labelText: amplitude 0 → null.
- radiusFraction: .035 floor; loudest = 1; ampMax 0 → .035.

colorRamp
- The stops equal the hex values.
- srgbToLinear matches the formula to 1e-7.
- restingDotDisplayRgb(t) = .874·.9025·lin + .126·bg.
- legibleEdgeLinear floors the peak channel at .55 and keeps hue.

geometry
- viewBasis is right-handed for all 7 views.
- projectToView: XZ → [p0, p2]; YZ → [p1, p2]; 1D Y → [p1, 0].
- fitOrtho: one scale; the larger extent fills 88%; a zero extent is safe.
- equivalentOrthoDepth(12.7185) = 13.0384 ± 1e-3.
- ballRadiusCss: rf 1 at depth √170 → 42.797 px diameter; dpr 2 gives the same CSS size; the 200 device px clamp; the pulse.
- labelBox: the drawn box equals the collision box.
- placeLabels: a 2.9 px gap is hidden and 3.0 px is kept; priority follows order; off-screen or behind-camera labels are hidden and do not block others; buffers are reused.
- pickPoint: inside a disc; topmost of an overlap; nearest within 6 px; unrevealed excluded.
- drawOrder: stable. gridLines: step in {1, 2, 5}·10^k with 6-12 lines. currentPointIndex edge cases.

transition
- t = 0 and t = 1 give the endpoints.
- The plan is 'rotate' for 3D/2D pairs and 'fade' for anything with 1D.
- The mask is binary at every t.
- Reduced motion → instant.

revealClock: 'all' → Infinity; ageFactors mirror the shader (pulse at age 0 = 1.6 + 1.3·flux).

shaders: the GLSL contains the constants; matteFragment equals the v0.7 string literal stored in the test.

origin: source-file, transcode and unknown cases; formatGroup covers mp3/mpga/aac/m4a/wav/ogg/flac.

waveformMath / overview
- A constant signal → min = max. A spike lands in the right column.
- Every sample is counted exactly once when N is not divisible by cols. N < 2·cols → line mode.
- sharedPeak of silence → 1 plus a flag.
- playheadFraction: before → null; midpoint → .5; after → null; loop wraps; both clock paths agree.

selfCheck: the real pipeline.ts analyzeSamples on a seeded 6 s synthetic 22050 Hz signal passes; a 1-sample shift fails; one altered amplitude fails and names its index.

measuredRows
- Row order and units. Strength = amp/max, with 'under 1%'. Silence → '— (digital silence)'.
- The bin step comes from frequencyRange, with fallback.
- Every number equals the formatted payload field.

exports
- The input is not mutated. The omitted fields are removed. Unknown and v2 fields are kept inside cloud.
- Simulated production unwrap gives the flat payload with sorted points and identical edges.
- displaySettings is as specified. Upload id rename follows the pipeline's format.

GUARDS
- claimText, copyCoverage, notebookVerbatim (reads 03_Research_Notebook, including the C05 template and 007:383).
- devIsolation, brandIsolation (the OpenGate cast exists only in gates.ts), gatesClosed.
- @ts-expect-error type tests on the gated components.
- purity: the pure-module import rules.
- distLeaks.
